Our 3rd year Pharmacy Interns play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise, while developing their own skills in preparation for increasing responsibility.
As a 3rd year Pharmacy Intern, you will be focused on applying didactic learning from pharmacy school into real-world practice to become ready for a Pharmacist role. Under the direction of your preceptor, you will complete a comprehensive training roadmap designed to show you first-hand what it’s like to be part of a pharmacy team while gaining an overview of store, district, and regional operations. You will gain valuable hands-on experience through a training roadmap that includes a combination of Key Learning Experiences (KLEs), activities, and time spent with leaders in your district. While in the pharmacy, you will assist the pharmacy team to ensure that pharmacy operations run smoothly, our patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately, and we are providing caring service that exceeds patient expectations. You will learn to operate as part of the pharmacy team through consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication. Throughout your shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, you will learn to demonstrate empathy and genuine care, and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered.
3rd year Pharmacy Interns are responsible for completion of a comprehensive training roadmap, focusing on KLEs that build aptitude in the following areas. As tenure increases, 3rd year Pharmacy Interns take on increasing responsibility of the safety and effectiveness of operations in the pharmacy, including but not limited to:
Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists and Technicians manage and improve patient health
Following pharmacy workflow procedures at each pharmacy workstation (i.e., production, pick-up, drive-thru, and drop-off) for safe and accurate prescription fulfillment
Contributing to positive patient experiences showing empathy and genuine care: creating heartfelt and personalized moments while serving patients at pick-up, drive-thru, and over the phone; keeping patients healthy by offering immunizations and other services at the register and over the phone; and demonstrating compassionate care by solving or escalating patient problems
Offering to counsel, fielding medical questions, and soliciting information on a patient’s medical history to provide optimal care, when appropriate under the direct supervision of a licensed pharmacist
Taking telephonic prescriptions from the prescriber, and calling the prescriber to clarify prescriptions or facilitate medication changes, where allowed by state regulation
Maintaining the highest level of self-awareness and providing in-the-moment coaching, training, and mentoring to pharmacy team members while sharing best practices
Completing basic inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc.
Contributing to a high-performing team, embracing a growth mindset, and being receptive to feedback; actively seeking opportunities to expand clinical and technical knowledge needed to better assist patients
Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic; voluntarily traveling to stores in the market to work shifts as needed by the business
Understanding and complying with all relevant federal, state, and local laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles. Complying with CVS policies and procedures to ensure patient safety, compliance with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, and to protect patient privacy and security
Delivering additional patient health care services (e.g., immunizations, point-of-care testing, and voluntarily staffing offsite clinics), where allowable by law and supported by required training and certification
Where permissible, the 3rd year Pharmacy Intern may also support immunizations, which includes the following responsibilities:
Completing additional licensure and training requirements, in compliance with state Board of Pharmacy regulations, to obtain Technician Immunizer status to support preparing and administering vaccines
Educating patients about the importance of vaccines and referring patients to the Pharmacist-on-duty for vaccination questions
Monitoring for, and responding to, adverse reactions; reporting adverse reaction events per public health requirements
Reviewing and collecting patient information; tracking and documenting for each applicable patient

Job Posting Title:
Disney Experiences (Disney Eats) Public Relations and Digital Communications Intern, Spring 2027
Req ID:
10158805
Job Description:
About the Role & Program
The Walt Disney Company has spent 100 years immersing audiences in new, spectacular experiences through groundbreaking technology. As a Disney intern, your work would inspire innovation and bring fresh perspectives that impact guests and consumers worldwide.
At Disney, we’re storytellers. We make the impossible possible. The Walt Disney Company is an entertainment and technological leader. Walt’s passion was to continuously envision new ways of storytelling to move audiences around the world, a passion that remains our touchstone in an enterprise that stretches from theme parks, resorts, and a cruise line to sports, news, movies, and a variety of other businesses. Uniting each endeavor is a commitment to creating and delivering unforgettable experiences, and we’re constantly striving to enhance them.
Disney Experiences brings the magic of Disney stories and franchises to life through theme parks, resorts, cruise ships, unique vacation experiences, consumer products, and more around the world. Our talented team of Cast Members, Crew Members, Imagineers, and employees delivers unparalleled service, entertainment, and imagination, bringing a range of authentic, immersive stories to life across the globe. You would have the opportunity to be a part of this amazing team!
This internship is a full-time opportunity for six months, from January 2027 through June 2027.
What You Will Do
The Disney Eats PR and Digital Communications Intern's primary responsibility is to support ongoing communication and promotion for Disney Eats, the Disney Experiences brand for global food and beverage. The Disney Eats Intern will gain experience building internal/external relationships and external social media partners within the Disney organization. The intern will also gain experience in professional writing and graphic design/photography. This position reports directly to the Digital Integration Specialist. The intern will have the following responsibilities:
Be part of the Disney Eats team, producing relevant creative content across various social platforms, including Disney Parks Blog, Disney Eats Instagram, and Facebook.
Ideate, capture, and edit social content for Disney Eats throughout the parks and resorts, including photography and video.
Identify and write engaging audience-focused blogs.
Support Food & Beverage aspects of Public Relations/Broadcast media events, from planning to execution.
Monitor and interact with social comments on Disney Eats social platforms.
Manage Smartsheet for all blogs, ensuring all copy and assets are accurate and ready to craft the blog.
Pull social stats for weekly blog reports.
Help route social approvals from teams across the company.
Submit Project Request forms for blog content.
Assist in updating and maintaining the Disney Eats photo library.
​Please Apply If You Are/Have
Flexible, resourceful, and thrive in a fast-paced, changing, and growing environment (No two days are ever alike in this role).
Work well with cross-functional teams and build relationships.
Comfortable working collaboratively with team members at all levels.
Demonstrated attentiveness to detail and ability to prioritize time.
Proficient in Microsoft Office 365.
Able to manage competing priorities and communicate updates effectively while under pressure.
Willing to contribute your skills while always being open to learning and confident to ask questions.
Knowledge of social media platforms and best practices.
It Would Also Be Great If You Have
Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Keynote, Adobe Creative Suite, WordPress, iOS operating system, Smartsheet, or Monday.com.
Previous communications experience.
An ability to write for various platforms and a love of storytelling are ideal.
Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, videography, and/or photography.
Experience with social tracking and metrics sites such as Sprinklr and Adobe Analytics.
Previous experience working on social media in an academic or professional setting; posting and writing in the voice/tone of an organization.
Proven campaign and event planning experience.
Previous Disney experience with knowledge of Walt Disney World property and products.
Education
A junior or senior pursuing a degree in Public Relations, Public Affairs, Communications, Journalism, Digital Media, Customer Engagement, Marketing, or other relevant subjects.
Required Materials
A portfolio showcasing your best written and visual work is required. For full consideration, please include a link to your portfolio on your résumé. Applicants without a portfolio will not be considered to have a complete application packet and may not be fully considered for the position. Please visit our support site for additional information.
Eligibility Requirements & Program Information
Candidates for this opportunity MUST meet all the requirements below
Be enrolled in an accredited college/university, pursuing a degree, taking at least one class at the time of application, OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship.
Have not completed one year of continual employment on a Disney Internship or Disney College Program.
Be at least 18 years of age.
Possess unrestricted work authorization.
Additional Information
The approximate dates of this internship are January 2027 through June 2027.
Fully available from Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time Zone, with possible weekends or shifts that are outside of these hours for the duration of the internship, 40 hours each week.
Able to provide own housing for the duration of the internship program in the Orlando, Florida area.
Able to provide/have reliable transportation to/from work.
Be aligned with The Disney Look appearance guidelines.
We provide limited housing opportunities for Florida-based Disney Interns through American Campus Communities. For more information, click here.

Job Posting Title:
WDI Master Planning Intern, Glendale, Spring 2027
Req ID:
10160961
Job Description:
WDI Master Planning Intern (Glendale)  
About the Role & Program  
Be a part of an innovative team and culture… 
Walt Disney Imagineering is the creative force that imagines, designs and brings to life all Disney theme parks, resorts, attractions and cruise ships worldwide. Working across a spectrum of disciplines that range from creative and conceptual to scientific and technical, Imagineers blend an innovative mixture of storytelling, art, science and technology to create immersive experiences, memorable destinations, and innovative entertainment for families around the globe. 
The approximate date of this internship is January 2027 to June 2027 and will be located in Glendale/Anaheim, CA.
What You Will Do  
The Master Planning Studio stewards the master planning process, communicates key data and context for planning decisions, and contributes to projects through thoughtful planning advice and support enabling the full development potential for our resorts! The Master Planning studio focuses on five key areas of expertise: Land Planning, Urban & Regional Planning, Transportation & Infrastructure planning, Environmental Planning & Permitting, and Real Estate Development & Entitlements. 
We are looking for a Master Planning intern who will have the opportunity to support the Walt Disney Imagineering Master Planning functions in one or more areas, including land and urban planning, transportation and infrastructure planning, land strategy design work, and/or real estate development and entitlements. We manage the long-term development framework for sustainable growth of each resort and provide expertise to support new business opportunities. You will have the opportunity to: 
Support the Master Planning Studio on relevant, day-to-day, planning-related design issues 
Provide creative, production and/or technical land and urban planning support to the Master Planning and/or project specific teams across Walt Disney Imagineering 
Provide planning and design documentation in the form of graphic illustrations, imagery, boards, color renderings, and research and documentation on assigned projects 
Work closely with the Designer and/or team leaders to coordinate and assist in completing site planning analysis, 3D visualization and property-wide master planning initiatives and services 
Build graphic visualizations and presentation storylines 
Conduct research and provide data analysis to help inform short and long-term planning and development decisions 
Provide inputs and updates to a global planning database 
Monitor and analyze industry trends and market changes 
Required Qualifications & Skills  
Ability to visualize and communicate complex information in simple and bold ways 
Experience with graphically communicating and problem solving via sketching, digital design, etc. 
Ability to quickly analyze and synthesize data to apply to planning and design strategy 
Ability to learn key project delivery methods while working on a variety of project types and scales 
Advanced design drawing capabilities in Adobe Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign)

Job Description:
Job Title: Retail Pharmacy Intern
Department: Pharmacy
FLSA: Hourly
Revision Date: 07/2026
About Hy-Vee
At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.
The Role and Why It's Important
Our Retail Pharmacy Interns gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced retail pharmacy setting while working toward their pharmacy degree. In this role, you'll fill prescriptions under the supervision of a registered pharmacist, assist with inventory and quality assurance, and help deliver the exceptional patient care that Hy-Vee is known for.
If you are an enrolled pharmacy student who is eager to learn, detail-oriented, and passionate about patient health, we'd love to have you on our team.
What You'll Do
No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:
Provide prompt, friendly customer service by greeting customers with a smile and making every interaction a positive one
Fill and help process prescriptions under the supervision of a registered pharmacist in accordance with all state and federal statutes and regulations
Prepare prescriptions and affix labels to prescription containers
Report any medication errors to appropriate personnel
Assist with inventory control including ordering, stocking merchandise, checking invoices, and entering inventory information
Assist with monthly inventory and follow security and regulatory procedures including Quality Assurance Programs
Assist in training pharmacy employees
Maintain the cleanliness of the pharmacy and dispensing area
Maintain the confidentiality of customers' private medical information and prescription drug pricing in accordance with HIPAA
Work with co-workers as a team to ensure strict adherence to standard operating procedures and facility policies
Maintain a professional appearance at all times
Assist in other areas of the store as needed and take on special projects as assigned
Adhere to all Hy-Vee policies and store guidelines
Report to work when scheduled and on time
Your Skills
Apply logical and scientific thinking to solve problems involving both abstract and concrete variables
Perform arithmetic, algebraic, and geometric calculations accurately
Compose original correspondence, follow technical manuals, and evaluate technical data
Counsel and advise customers and interact professionally with patients, healthcare providers, and team members
Maintain a high level of discretion and integrity when handling confidential patient and financial information
Reporting Relationships
Accountable and Reports to: Store Director; Store Manager; Pharmacy Department Manager
Education and Experience
Currently enrolled in an accredited college of pharmacy required
Registered with the State Pharmacy Board as an intern required
Six months or less of similar or related work experience preferred
Physical Requirements
Ability to frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in the pharmacy and dispensing area, including extended periods at a pharmacy counter or workstation while filling and processing prescriptions
Ability to count, pour, package, and label medications, and fill prescriptions under pharmacist supervision, in accordance with state and federal pharmacy regulations
Exposure to bloodborne pathogens and sharps (needles, lancets) associated with pharmacy operations and, where certified, immunization administration
Ability to perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties
Working Environment
This is a fast-paced role in a retail pharmacy where you will handle multiple tasks throughout your shift including filling prescriptions, answering the telephone, and assisting customers. You will have frequent exposure to noise and occasional exposure to hazardous chemicals or solvents. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.
Are you ready to smile, apply today.
Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.

About Marvell
Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.
At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.
Your Team, Your Impact
As a test development engineer in the Operations business group, you will test features on the silicon semiconductor chips Marvell produces for internal and external customers. You will make sure we don’t ship out any underperforming units. You’ll work closely with design to make sure their chip features are testable and that the results meet the customer’s specifications. You may even have to write new code or develop new testing strategies when our chips outpace the capabilities of current testing equipment.
What You Can Expect
In this on-site environment in Santa Clara, CA, you will work under the direction of a mentor and team lead to verify code, verify the test program across a large number of individual parts, and flag any parts giving unexpected results that should be investigated further. You’ll replicate the work on the test bench environment and do a correlation exercise with the design and verification teams to determine a root cause of any unexpected behavior.
This team uses Python, Visual Basic, and C for various aspects of test development as well as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, Teradyne Ultraflex tester and Advantest 93K testers. This team owns all test engineering activities related to the new product introduction (NPI) plan including new silicon bring-up, release of sampling test programs, release of qualification and characterization test programs, release of production test programs, and optimization of test time and yield.
You’ll work very closely with members of your own team as well as people from different design groups, marketing, program management, quality assurance, and other operations teams to move projects forward successfully.
What We're Looking For
Currently pursuing a MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Basic understanding of hardware products, PCBs, electronics manufacturing, or product development processes.
Coursework or project experience related to electronics, circuits, embedded systems, manufacturing, or mechanical design is preferred.
Ability to organize technical information, summarize data, and communicate clearly.
Comfortable working in a team environment and learning from engineers across multiple disciplines and regions.
Expected Base Pay Range (USD)
30 - 61, $ per hour.
The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.


Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements
Marvell is committed to providing exceptional, comprehensive benefits that support our employees at every stage - from internship to retirement and through life’s most important moments. Our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. Highlights for our interns: medical, dental, and vision coverage, perks and discounts, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and paid holidays. Additional compensation may be available for intern PhD candidates. We look forward to sharing more with you during the interview process.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.
Any applicant who requires a reasonable accommodation during the selection process should contact Marvell HR Helpdesk at TAOps@marvell.com.

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.
These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

The International Veterinary Health (IVH) team at our Company's Animal Health division works with governments and intergovernmental agencies throughout the world on the control of transboundary and emerging diseases with a One Health impact. Key diseases are rabies, Foot and Mouth Disease, Lumpy Skin Disease, African Swine Fever, Tuberculosis, and Avian Influenza.
The team has a One Health One Welfare approach to their work. They work on innovative approaches to disease control, with the integration of technology to help disease surveillance and vaccination monitoring. Previously they have produced the emergence website providing information on disease outbreaks, and the emergence podcast featuring experts in many disease areas.
About the position:
The successful applicant will be a member of the International Veterinary Health team during the period of the internship and will be involved in team meetings and planning sessions. Working with the team, the candidate will gain a full understanding of the role of the pharmaceutical industry in improving both human and animal lives. The candidate will learn about public-private partnerships and see them in action, as well as gain insights into the political drivers and barriers to disease control. The candidate will be a part of meetings that discuss disease control and how to introduce true solutions to make national vaccination campaigns more effective.
Specific projects may vary, dependent on the needs and priorities of the department at the time while taking into account specific interests of the applicant.
Previous projects include:
• Development of disease communication materials
• Development of technical bulletins for governments
• Planning of social media programs
• Planning of awareness campaigns, ex. Rabies360 Challenge
• Disease and market analysis
• Global policy review of specific diseases
• Development of a customer management system
• Logistics support, helping manage deliveries of vaccines
• The incorporation of technology and data management into health solutions

• Travel: International travel may be required to team meetings or conferences as applicable. The Company will cover the expenses of such or any other assignments under this internship.

• Candidates must have an interest in animal health, with a focus on veterinary public health.
• Candidates must have excellent interpersonal/communication, writing, presentation skills, and professional demeanor.
• Candidates must have general computer skills, which includes working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
• Candidates must have the ability to be organized, adapt to a changing environment, and prioritize accordingly, work independently and as part of a team.
• Candidates must demonstrate high ethical standards.
Project Follow-Up:
The candidate could be involved in one or more of the projects listed above, projects that could be extended past the internship period and which could allow the further involvement of the Candidate after the in-person portion of the internship is completed. Strategic Supplier Management is a rigorous, data-driven methodology which relies upon high quality market intelligence for suppliers, supply markets and supply chains, as well as strategic analysis and reporting of internal business requirements, supplier performance, spend and savings data.
Intern positions generally last 10-12 weeks and will include several projects.
This role will support several facets of the Research and Development Sourcing & Procurement organization. The successful candidate: prepares and conducts market intelligence gathering and strategic analysis; pre-negotiation planning; RFIs, RFP/Qs, and e-auctions; quotation analysis and cost modeling; financial solvency analysis, risk assessments, FCPA verification, and other compliance / due diligence assessments; supplier performance monitoring and issue resolution; budget planning process support and ongoing spend, savings, and compliance metrics reporting.
Research and Development Sourcing & Procurement is responsible for conducting strategic sourcing initiatives in support of drug discovery and development, specifically in the areas of discovery sciences, preclinical development, clinical development, regulatory affairs, and lab supplies and equipment, within our Research Labs.
General Responsibilities:
Support strategic and operating objectives for the procurement function including product sourcing, supply risk management, supplier performance improvement, cost reduction, supplier diversity development, working capital improvement, and supplier relationship management
Work with cross functional teams including Legal, Finance, Procure-to-Pay, internal stakeholders, and external suppliers
Conduct detailed market analyses looking at facts and data, with the objective of providing deep and meaningful insights
Implement procurement efforts and execute tactical procurement processes. Serve as a resource regarding processes, procedures and systems for procurement function.
Support selection of suppliers to ensure appropriate savings and service levels. Ensure that all legal contract requirements are met. Manage relationships with external contacts to ensure optimal team performance and to take appropriate actions by implementing contract negotiation, communication with suppliers and/or or modifying procedure to ensure customer satisfaction.
Enforce compliance with all Global Procurement policies and procedures by using a data driven business case approach.
Additional responsibilities are as follows:
Supplier and Supply Market Analysis – To conduct rigorous market intelligence and detailed supplier and supply market analyses, to provide deep and meaningful insight to Sourcing teams.
Cost Modeling / Cost reduction – To construct detailed cost models/purchase price analysis of goods and services that are supplied to our company. Supplier Performance Management – supplier performance monitoring, root cause investigation, issue management, risk assessment and mitigation

Tokyo Electron markets a wide range of semiconductor production equipment (SPE) products and provides outstanding service and support to semiconductor device manufacturers. An internship at TEL is a great opportunity for a student to gain valuable experience while engaging in technically challenging projects that provide value by advancing our technology.
Position Summary
TEL is seeking a summer intern with expertise in Multiphysics modeling, transport phenomena, and computational simulation to work in the Surface Preparation System (SPS) Advanced Technology Group (ATG) located in Austin, Texas. This intern will support the development of a novel multiscale modeling framework for semiconductor wet processing applications, with a focus on connecting wafer-scale transport phenomena and nanoscale feature etching behavior.
Responsibilities
Develop physics-based models describing transport and reaction phenomena in wet chemical semiconductor processing.
Build multiscale simulation frameworks linking wafer-scale flow, species transport, and thermal behavior to nanoscale feature etching dynamics.
Analyze simulation and experimental data to validate model predictions across a range of process parameters including wafer spin speed, chemical composition, dispense conditions, and temperature.
Support the development of advanced simulation methodologies for process optimization, technology development, and digital-twin implementation.
Collaborate on global projects with TEL U.S. R&D sites, manufacturing divisions, semiconductor customers, consortia, vendors, and academic partners.
Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, structured project management, and the ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
Qualifications
B.S. degree or higher (pursuing M.S. or Ph.D. preferred) in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computational Engineering, Materials Science, or related fields.
Strong understanding of transport phenomena including fluid dynamics, mass transfer, diffusion, convection-diffusion-reaction systems, and surface reaction kinetics.
Knowledge of multiscale modeling methodologies and reduced-order modeling techniques is desirable.
Familiarity with Macro transport Theory, homogenization methods, or other scale-bridging approaches is desirable.
Experience modeling transport in confined geometries, porous media, microfluidics, or high-aspect-ratio structures is desirable.
Experience with programming languages such as Python, MATLAB, C/C++, or Julia is desirable.
Experience with data-driven modeling, machine learning, or surrogate modeling approaches is a plus.
Relevant semiconductor manufacturing experience and/or knowledge of wet etching, wet cleaning, deposition, or advanced process technologies is preferred.
Experience working in a global and multicultural environment is preferred.
Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse technical audiences.

Who We Are 
The Texas Permanent School Fund (PSF) is a constitutionally established education endowment with more than 180 years of history supporting Texas public schools. Today, PSF manages more than $60 billion in assets through a diversified, long-term investment strategy designed to generate sustainable returns, preserve the Fund for future generations, and support Texas K–12 education.
Our portfolio spans a broad range of public and private market strategies, including public equities, private and public credit, real estate and real assets, private equity, absolute return strategies, venture capital, and co-investments. Across the portfolio, Texas PSF works with leading investment firms and managers across markets and strategies. Texas PSF is supported by strong operational, legal, financial, risk, and governance functions that help steward the Fund over the long term
In addition to providing permanent funding for Texas public schools, the Fund also supports the Bond Guarantee Program, helping school and charter districts access lower borrowing costs and directing more resources toward classrooms and students. Our work supports more than 5 million students across 1,000+ school districts statewide. Guided by fiduciary responsibility, integrity, and service to Texans, PSF combines institutional scale with an enduring mission: strengthening public education and investing in Texas’s future.
 Job Summary
As a Summer Intern at the Texas Permanent School Fund Corporation, you will gain hands-on experience supporting investment research, analysis, due diligence, and portfolio monitoring while working alongside experienced investment professionals. Interns contribute meaningful work, collaborate with asset class teams, complete a summer-long project, and present to senior leadership.

Full-time (40 hours per week)
Monday through Friday
Hybrid schedule: 4 days onsite, 1 day remote

Dedicated mentors across the investment team will provide guidance and support throughout the program. Your experience within each asset class may include:
Private Equity focuses on funds investing in underlying private companies across a broad range of enterprise values, sectors and geographies. Interns will be exposed to fund underwriting / due diligence, monitoring and reporting.
Real Estate/Real Assets focuses on funds investing in asset and asset-heavy businesses such as commercial real estate, infrastructure and natural resources investments. Interns will be exposed to fund underwriting / due diligence, portfolio monitoring and reporting.
Risk manages the Fund's overall risk and return to support the firm’s mission, covering all decisions except manager selection. Interns will be exposed to hands-on experience analyzing economic data, conducting peer research, developing economic models, Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA), Tactical Asset Allocation (TAA), macro research, board communications, risk appetite setting and monitoring, and performance measurement.
Credit focuses on funds investing in investment grade fixed income, high yielding corporate credit, structured credit and private credit. Interns will be exposed to fund underwriting / due diligence, portfolio monitoring and reporting, and individual company and capital structure analysis.
Absolute Return Strategies focus on allocating capital to trading-oriented hedge funds across market neutral equity and credit, relative value, macro, quant, and multi-strategy managers. Public Equity focuses on investing in long-only or long-biased equity funds. Interns will be exposed to fund sourcing, the underwriting and due diligence processes, portfolio construction, and the monitoring and reporting of existing allocations.

Are you looking for an exciting job where you can put your skills and talents to work at a company you can feel proud to be a part of? Do you want a workplace that will challenge you and offer you opportunities to learn and grow? A position at Xcel Energy could be just what you’re looking for.
At Xcel Energy, our employees are the driving force behind our success. So we make sure that, here, you can be your best. Doing work that makes a difference for neighbors and communities. Working with a team you can count on to push you. Expanding skills, staying ready for change, and capturing opportunities to grow. All with the support, rewards and recognition you need to thrive – during your internship and beyond.
The project includes supporting the nuclear oversight department with optimizing the audit process. The location will be primarily be at 414 Nicollet Mall, Minneapolis, MN but also be able to travel to Monticello, MN and Welch, MN.
Typical intern responsibilities may include but are not limited to:
1. Excel Spreadsheets and Database creations
2. Support audit team on technical reviews
3. Perform field observations
4. Documentation reviews
This position is for a May 24, 2027 start date. This position may have the possibility to extend beyond the internship’s initial term based on the candidate’s successful performance and Xcel Energy’s business needs.
Minimum Requirements:
Current student, Freshman or higher
Enrolled in an ABET accredited college or university and pursuing a degree in Engineering
In state travel, access to car is preferred
Able to work full-time during the summer (up to 40 hours a week) and commuting to the designated work location in-person, per our hybrid work policy.
Preferred Qualifications:
Self-Motivated
Programming skills
